beats.summary: Darryl feels unqualified during his interview at Athlead but is encouraged by employees with diverse backgrounds.

evidence.snippet: Darryl (freezes): Ummm… Alright. Obviously y'all look really busy, and uh, I don't want to waste your time anymore. Sorry, I just uhh… Obviously I'm not qualified to be here man, I'm… I'm a warehouse manager, you know…

Athlead Employee: Darryl, I was a newspaper editor.
Female Athlead Employee: Science teacher, volleyball coach.

beats.summary: Darryl impresses the Athlead employees by coming prepared with notes and receives a job offer despite accidentally killing a fish with a basketball shot.

evidence.snippet: Darryl: Yes, as a matter of fact, I uh… I wrote some down. There you go. Wow, this guy came prepared, it impresses me!

beats.summary: Pam supports Darryl's decision to take the job and move to Philadelphia despite her own mixed feelings.

evidence.snippet: Pam: No, I'm not upset. I'm really excited for Darryl… Maybe I'm a little disappointed that we'll be losing him.

beats.summary: The office employees move the copier into the annex, tearing up the carpet and revealing hardwood floors underneath.

evidence.snippet: Oscar: Everyone! Now that we have all this energy, why don't we move the copier into the annex like we've always wanted to?

Nellie: And we have torn up the carpet! Oh, we're going to be in so much trouble!
Oscar: Wait! It's beautiful. Hardwood! I always knew it was down here, I just never dreamed that I would actually see it.

beats.summary: Dwight jokes about Italian suits making one look like a mafia don and the undertaker from a non-existent island.

evidence.snippet: Dwight: Yeah, you don't want Italian. You'll look like a mafia don. Next thing you know, you'll be doing life in Rikers Island.
Dwight: That place doesn't exist. It's not a documented island. Ha ha, cartograph much?
